description: Operation-specific inputs: authorize requires region and marketplaceId; profiles requires connectionId; connections requires no additional input. Connections are scoped to the API-key owner, and OAuth tokens are backend-owned.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Required when operation=authorize. Amazon Ads region: NA, EU, or FE.

fields.name: marketplaceId
fields.description: Required when operation=authorize. Amazon marketplace identifier.

fields.name: accountName
fields.description: Optional display name for the authorization request.

fields.name: connectionId
fields.description: Required when operation=profiles. Owned Amazon Ads connection ID.
